review_rules: Use Snow Elf and Falmer terminology with historical precision; do not assume every source uses the terms identically
Gelebor and Vyrthur provide unusually valuable first-person testimony but remain individual witnesses rather than omniscient narrators
The cause and mechanism of Falmer transformation must preserve Dwemer agreement accounts, later testimony and uncertainty separately
Do not infer cultural continuity between ancient Snow Elf religion and every later Falmer community without evidence
Falmer language evidence should distinguish direct inscriptions/translations from scholarly reconstruction
Cross-link existing Snow Elves, Falmer, Dwemer, Blackreach, Forgotten Vale, Auri-El, Gelebor, Vyrthur, Auriel's Bow and Falmer-Dwemer records
